integrity: Complete theorem and proof are included; exact rational exhaustive checks over a stated finite parameter grid support but do not replace the proof. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: This finite-tip theorem concerns common fixed positive species richness, binary presence/absence, strictly bifurcating rooted ultrametric trees of at most four tips with positive edges and a fixed crown root; extra root stems, nonultrametric branches, pair-specific rerooting, weighted distances and larger tip sets are excluded. Numerical finite enumeration does not establish the universal proof.
title: Sharp quartet topology criterion for Jaccard–UniFrac rank reversal
